summary: Bound raw CLI and typed MCP marker requests with the same explicit Japan-window validator as sync.
reason: The provider raw marker endpoint must not accept an arbitrary geographical sweep through either public interface. Validation occurs before client construction and provider IO; missing-input dry-run previews retain their framework behavior.
validated_outcome: Both registered marker interfaces reject malformed, out-of-Japan and oversized windows. A valid typed marker window passes unchanged to the endpoint handler. Targeted regression tests pass.
